title: Patch World
card: Creatures whose brains learn while they live: when winter makes berries poisonous, learners stop eating them and frozen twins do not.
tagline: Creatures that learn while they live, and evolve across generations
kicker: A BRAIN THAT LEARNS WHILE IT LIVES
feature: Each creature's Cadence brain has real memory and a real state, runs in real time and learns while it lives. When winter makes berries poisonous, learners learn to leave them (99% eaten in summer, 5% late in winter); frozen twins do not.
howTo: Press Flip the season: berries turn poisonous. Watch the chart: the learners' teal line falls, the frozen twins' blue line stays up. Click a creature to watch its brain learn. Drop berries, roots or a predator on the map.
